g.text: Firmware: keep PB5 as an input and read it (1 = bridges off, stop switch used).

g.desc: Firmware: keep PB5 as an input and read it (1 = bridges off, stop switch used).

g.text: Set PB5 to output HIGH to stop from the GUI. Output LOW never enables anything.

g.desc: Set PB5 to output HIGH to stop from the GUI. Output LOW never enables anything.

g.text: DISABLE = 1 switches all three DRV8873S bridges off (Hi-Z). R204 pulls it up,

g.desc: DISABLE = 1 switches all three DRV8873S bridges off (Hi-Z). R204 pulls it up,

g.text: the closed stop switch holds it low through R205.

g.desc: the closed stop switch holds it low through R205.

g.text: The MCU pin PB5 (DRV_OFF) can only add an OFF: D202 lets it push DISABLE high,

g.desc: The MCU pin PB5 (DRV_OFF) can only add an OFF: D202 lets it push DISABLE high,

g.text: and R104 is too weak to pull it low.

g.desc: and R104 is too weak to pull it low.

g.text: DISABLE TRUTH TABLE (the stop switch always wins)

g.desc: DISABLE TRUTH TABLE (the stop switch always wins)
